title: Development of Infrastructure for Tourism at Navadra Lighthouse.
summary: Civil works to develop tourism infrastructure at Navadra Lighthouse, Bhatia, Dev-Bhumi Dwarka district, Gujarat, tendered by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Jamnagar.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Pandit Nehru Marg, Jamnagar

sites.name: Navadara Lighthouse, P.O. Bhatia, Dist. Dev-Bhumi Dwarka (Gujarat) 361315

scope.item: Development of Infrastructure for Tourism at Navadra Lighthouse (item percentage bid; no BOQ in this notice)

money.notes: Estimated cost including GST. EMD by Demand Draft/FDR/Deposit at call receipt of scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Jamnagar, payable at Jamnagar, valid 180 days from technical bid opening; MSME firms must submit EMD, no exemption.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Similar works completed in central/state govt. department/undertaking in last 7 years: three works each >= 40% of estimated cost, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80%; similar works = civil construction or maintenance of any building or civil structure; values updated at 7% per annum
Valid PAN card and GST registration
Joint ventures and consortium not permitted
Valid registration of appropriate class and category (civil) in central/state govt. department/undertaking, valid on last date of bid submission
Letter-pad declaration of not blacklisted/debarred (Annex-11.2(A)); unconditional price bid undertaking (Annex-11.2(B)); tender acceptance letter (Annex-11.2(C))
Bank solvency certificate for at least 40% of estimated cost, not older than 1 year
Average annual turnover of those three years at least 30% of estimated cost, CA certified
notes: Notice only (Section I, pages numbered 3-7); no BOQ. Invites item percentage bids from Building Works category contractors.
